host.description: CONSPACE ROOMS is an interactive web installation created by Sinaida Krivchenko (https://sinaida.eu), a new media artist, who designed the experience and wrote the code. It presents SOULS, a series of artworks by UVALISS, the artist Alisa Feer (https://uvaliss.ru/).
